Description: Creates a new Loan or Guarantee product. Validates DTO fields with conditional validation by productType. Calculates disbursement frequency limit. Serializes arrays (loanTypes, eligibility sub-fields) to JSON strings. Sets status to Approved automatically. Catches SequelizeUniqueConstraintError (409).
Authorization: JWT + RBAC via Access Management Service
Criticality Reason: Product creation defines the financial instruments (loans, guarantees) the platform offers. Incorrect products can lead to wrong pricing, disbursement failures, or compliance issues. Used by product managers to configure the platform's offerings.
Important Log Fields: product_name, product_type (Loan|Guarantee), currency, ceiling_amount, interest_rate, created_by, trace_id, span_id
Sensitive Data: JWT token (contains identificationNumber, autenticatorQrCode, accountToken, phone, email). user.id stored as createdById.
Dependencies: DB: Product.create (Sequelize/MSSQL). HTTP: Access Management Service (guard). Kafka: logging.info topic (via LoggerService).
Existing Observability: Winston DailyRotateFile + Console + Kafka logging.info. Manual @Trace/@Span decorators extract x-trace-id/x-span-id headers for structured log context.
Observability Gap: No custom Prometheus metrics. No OTel tracing (manual trace/span extraction only, no actual spans). No domain event. Logging exists but is Winston-based, not SDK structured.
Notes: Has best logging in this service (structured context with traceId/spanId). Good candidate for SDK migration showcase. Update body accepts 'any' type — no DTO validation.
